content: प्रामाणिक {%a.%} (-की|{%f.%}) .²1 Established by proof, founded or resting on authority. .²2 Founded on the authority of scriptures (शास्त्रसिद्ध). .²3 Authentic, credible. .²4 Relating to a प्रभाण, <ab>q. v.</ab> .{@-कः@} .²1 One who accepts proof. .²2 One who is conversant with the Pramāṇas of the Naiyāyikas, a logician. .²3 The head of a trade.
